pensamiento:
I'm checking the user story criteria one by one. QUS-001 through QUS-003 pass: the role and action are there, it has a single objective, and there are no parenthetical notes. QUS-004 looks like a problem, because the stated benefit just restates the action rather than giving a real justification, so I'm marking it as a defect.

I'm going through the remaining criteria: QUS-005 has no technology imposed, so it passes. QUS-006 is less clear-cut, since "more helpful" is vague, but the acceptance criteria spell out the message content, so I'm leaning toward a pass while noting that the baseline behaviour isn't described. QUS-007 through QUS-009 also look fine, since no conflicting or duplicate story turned up and the format matches the rest of the backlog.

I'm going through the remaining invariant checks now. INV-001 has no dependencies, so it passes. INV-002 is less clear, since the stated benefit is just the action restated rather than a separate value, so I'm leaning toward marking it as a defect too, the same as QUS-004.

I'm working through the remaining invariant checks: INV-003 looks estimable and small enough, though it's unclear whether the extension check is case-sensitive or applies to every upload screen. INV-004 and INV-005 also pass, since the criteria are observable. For DOR-001, I don't see any external dependency, so it passes too.

I've marked the criteria with defects: QUS-004 and INV-002, since the stated benefit only restates the action. The rest of the checks pass, and the defects don't concern size, so this will be sent back. Next I'll look up the estimate and the scale.
